verdict: Not yet. On the 59 uncontested real-text cases, as two independent judges re-judged them, the segmenters are 85.9% exact strict and lenient (152 of 177 attempts; 76% to 94% by a case bootstrap), against round 6's 92.1% on 55 cases (85% to 98%): the intervals overlap, so neither a gain nor a loss is shown, and this sample holds more derivations (12 against 7), where most misses fall. Both fixes work on what they target: the comparative affix test decided every ge- word of the adversarial batch right and fixed Geschichte and Gemüt, and the relative sense check fixed Verneigung and Musikerleben 🎧. The misses that remain are systematic, not rare-word noise: the sense check choosing a prefix + noun bracketing over prefix + verb (erzählen, and verfilmen in tuning), none winning on a low sense yes for a true derivation (sonderbar, Gewässer), a head that is no word (Ministerium), and suffix-base routes (ruhig, Wirtschafterin). Tuning should go on with fixes 1 to 5. Rescored 2026-10-27 after the user's ruling, no real-text row is contested: all 60 score 84.4% strict and lenient (152 of 180; 75% to 93% by a case bootstrap). überhaupt now fails as beinahe and zuletzt do, its über linked to the Prefix über- where the gold has the ADP; fix 5, widened to every particle-like part outside a verb, covers all three. Round 6, rescored the same way, gives 89.1% on its 58 uncontested cases (81% to 96%): the intervals still overlap.
